themes.description: Users are experiencing frequent crashes, lags, and technical glitches while using the Zerodha app, which affects their ability to execute trades and manage their investments.
themes.business_impact: High risk of order execution errors, missed trade opportunities, and potential financial losses due to technical issues.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: Insufficient infrastructure, inadequate testing, and poor coding practices are contributing to the app's poor performance.
themes.action_plan:
• Address app performance issues by optimizing infrastructure
• Improve testing and QA processes
• Fix bugs and errors in the app code
• Implement load balancing to handle high user traffic
• Provide timely updates and patches to resolve technical issues

themes.description: Users are unable to view charts or experience frequent crashes when trying to open them, which is affecting their ability to make informed investment decisions.
themes.business_impact: Loss of user trust, decreased user engagement due to frustration with the app, potential revenue loss from missed investment opportunities.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The root cause of this issue may be related to a bug in the chart rendering engine, causing it to crash or not display properly, or an issue with the app's storage or data retrieval mechanics.
themes.action_plan:
• Investigate and fix the chart rendering engine bug
• Conduct thorough testing on various devices and chart types to identify the cause
• Implement a data integrity check to prevent data corruption
• Consider implementing a fallback display mode for charts in case of errors.
